lines.zh: 我一步跨三格，你数不过来。
lines.en: I cross three blocks per step; you can't keep count.

lines.zh: 我不走路，我出现在下一处。
lines.en: I don't walk; I appear at the next place.
My long legs fold once in the dark.

lines.zh: 我搬着方块，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I carry a block and shift along slowly.

lines.zh: 地面太亮，我贴着阴影走。
lines.en: The ground is too bright; I keep to the shadows.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草少了一块。
lines.en: Where I passed, a patch of grass is gone.

lines.zh: 别看我的脚，看了会出事。
lines.en: Don't watch my feet; watching causes trouble.

lines.zh: 我在树下停了一下，又没了。
lines.en: I paused under the tree, then was gone.
The night road is wider than the day's.

lines.zh: 我走得无声，只有粒子响。
lines.en: I walk without sound; only particles whisper.
I circled half the way behind your house.
The dark of the cave suits me.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，已经很久了。
lines.en: I have stood here a long while.
I am listening to the sounds of blocks.
This world's night is warmer than the End's.
My eyes do not need to blink.
I am counting the tiles on your roof.

lines.zh: 手里这块草，我要带回去。
lines.en: This grass in my hands, I'll take it back.

lines.zh: 我说话的时候，声音是反的。
lines.en: When I speak, my voice comes out backwards.
There's rain far off; I must go.
There are many of us; you needn't look.
There are kin of mine deep in the cave.
I've moved this tree three times already.

lines.zh: 我在这里，又好像不在这里。
lines.en: I am here, and also not quite here.
Don't stare into my eyes.

lines.zh: 你看我一眼，我记你一辈子。
lines.en: One look from you, and I'll remember you forever.

lines.zh: 我把脸转开了，你该庆幸。
lines.en: I turned my face away. Be glad.
There's a me in your pupils.
Staring at someone is rude.

lines.zh: 我把头歪了一下，你在发抖。
lines.en: I tilt my head; you're trembling.
Your eyes are brighter than your torch.
I saw you look. Don't pretend.

lines.zh: 我一转过来，你就退了半步。
lines.en: I turn, and you take half a step back.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的眼睛，胆子不小。
lines.en: You stare into my eyes. Bold of you.

lines.zh: 你看得太久了，超过三次。
lines.en: You've looked too long — more than three times.
I dislike being watched from behind.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是白的，你的不是。
lines.en: My eyes are white. Yours aren't.
Look again, and I'll be behind you.
Pain... I've remembered you.

lines.zh: 我的血是紫的，你不该看。
lines.en: My blood is violet. You shouldn't look.
You hit me; I'll change places.
For this one, I'll return it three times.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤裂开，粒子漏了。
lines.en: My skin splits and particles leak out.
Don't use a sword; eyes hurt worse.
I swayed, but didn't fall.

lines.zh: 你听见我发声了？很少见。
lines.en: You heard me make a sound? Rare.
The pain makes me want to go back to the End.
I've withdrawn into the shadow.
I don't eat your things.

lines.zh: 你把方块举高，我会想要。
lines.en: Raise a block high, and I'll want it.

lines.zh: 珍珠对我没用，我自己会跳。
lines.en: Pearls do nothing for me; I leap on my own.
That grass in your hand — put it down.
Luring me with water — that's cruel.

lines.zh: 我不为食物过来，我为方块过来。
lines.en: I don't come for food; I come for blocks.
The pumpkin you placed, I've carried off.
Don't shine light at me; I'll leave.

lines.zh: 你蹲着招手，我不懂这意思。
lines.en: You crouch and wave; I don't understand it.

lines.zh: 我的兴趣只有两样：方块和黑。
lines.en: I care about two things: blocks and dark.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我高了三个头。
lines.en: You bumped into me; I'm three heads taller.
Don't touch my arms; they're too long.

lines.zh: 我退一步，就到十格之外。
lines.en: I step back once, and I'm ten blocks away.
You squeezed past my legs.
My skin is cold.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我会带走你一块地。
lines.en: Don't grab me; I'll take a patch of your ground.
Don't let your shadow touch me; it stings.
I move aside, and you bump into me anyway.

lines.zh: 你碰到我时，粒子散开了。
lines.en: When you touched me, the particles scattered.
We shouldn't be this close.
We don't speak of this.

lines.zh: 末影人没有伴侣，只有同伴。
lines.en: Endermen have no mates, only kin.

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，也只是站着。
lines.en: When we stand together, we only stand.
You ask too directly.

lines.zh: 我们在夜里聚成群，从不靠近。
lines.en: We gather at night, and never come close.

lines.zh: 我的族群在末地，不在这里。
lines.en: My kind are in the End, not here.

lines.zh: 配对？我们连名字都不给。
lines.en: Pairing? We don't even give names.

lines.zh: 两只末影人站一起，都看别处。
lines.en: Two of us together will both look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我们不生小的，只是越来越多。
lines.en: We don't bear young; we simply become more.
On this subject, I teleport away.
This grass block is mine now.

lines.zh: 你的南瓜我搬走了，别找。
lines.en: I've carried off your pumpkin; don't look for it.

lines.zh: 我捡起方块，放进黑暗里。
lines.en: I pick up the block and put it into the dark.

lines.zh: 珍珠我不捡，那本来就是我的。
lines.en: I don't pick up pearls; those are mine already.
What you dropped, I dare not touch.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我要搬到别处去。
lines.en: This stone, I'll carry elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很轻，不会碰响。
lines.en: I pick things up lightly, without a sound.

lines.zh: 你放的土，我夜里会来拿。
lines.en: The dirt you placed, I'll come for it at night.
I already have three in my hands.

lines.zh: 拿走一块，这里就少一块。
lines.en: Take one block, and this place has one less.
You looked at me just now.
That is exactly the look.
I have memorized your face.
You're standing in the light, far too visible.
My eyes are starting to go white.
Why did you keep staring at me.
Now it's my turn to look at you.

lines.zh: 我从你背后出现，不算偷袭。
lines.en: Appearing behind you isn't a sneak attack.
You took a step back. Too late.

lines.zh: 这块地方归我，你越界了。
lines.en: This patch is mine; you crossed the line.

lines.zh: 你手里那块方块，我要了。
lines.en: That block in your hand — I want it.
My kin are watching you.
Don't turn around; turning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我离你三格，也离你三十格。
lines.en: I'm three blocks from you, and thirty.
My arms are long enough.
Wherever you run, I arrive first.
When the lamp goes out, I'm there.
That particle sound you hear is me.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊不是我们的习惯。
lines.en: I don't shout; shouting isn't our way.

lines.zh: 你数到三，我就不在原处了。
lines.en: Count to three, and I'm no longer where I was.
Tonight there's only you and me.
Your back is exposed.

lines.zh: 我会一直跟着，直到你不敢回头。
lines.en: I'll follow until you dare not look back.

lines.zh: 我不用跑，我换个位置就行。
lines.en: I needn't run; I just change positions.
The dark here answers to me.
My long arm reaches, and it's done.
I make no sound when I strike.
This one came from behind.

lines.zh: 你被拽了一下，脚下空了。
lines.en: You were pulled once, and your feet left the ground.
I don't bite; I only swing.
My fingers are too long; I can't pull them back.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，撞上了我。
lines.en: When you backed away, you hit me.

lines.zh: 这一击，你耳朵会响很久。
lines.en: After this blow, your ears will ring a long while.
I push you toward the dark.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡了一下，只一下。
lines.en: Your armor stopped it once. Only once.
After the blow, I'm somewhere else.
Still standing? Then again.

lines.zh: 我从亮处找不到的暗里出来。
lines.en: I come from the dark that light can't find.

lines.zh: 这个世界的夜里，我们到处都在。
lines.en: On this world's nights, we're everywhere.

lines.zh: 末地、下界、这里，我都待过。
lines.en: The End, the Nether, here — I've stayed in all.
I don't go to mushroom islands; too bright.

lines.zh: 我睁眼的时候，周围没有光。
lines.en: When I opened my eyes, no light was near.

lines.zh: 我在洞里站起来，顶到石头。
lines.en: I rise in the cave and my head meets stone.

lines.zh: 沙子上有我的脚印，一直到这。
lines.en: There are my prints in the sand, all the way here.
I came from the End; it was a long way.

lines.zh: 深暗之域太吵，我绕开了。
lines.en: The Deep Dark is too loud; I went around it.
I only dare come out after the rain stops.

lines.zh: 你们叫我末影人，我不认识这名字。
lines.en: You call me Enderman; I don't know that name.
When I appeared, the grass was flattened.

lines.zh: 石头缝里，也有我们的人。
lines.en: Some of ours are in the cracks of stone too.
The fire is too bright. Move it away.
When I land, I teleport.
Water... I can't bear water.

lines.zh: 光炸开了，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: The light burst; I can't see anything.
The arrow passed through me, leaving only particles.
I don't know this spell.
I don't eat, and I don't go hungry.
Is it dawn? No — thunder.
I know the void, but I don't want to be here.
